## Où j'en suis
Terraform for the PostgreSQL 17 blue/green upgrade on the analytics RDS is ready as draft PR kestrel-analytics/infra#57: parameter group family now derived from the major version, blue/green enabled on staging (16.4 → 17.2), prod prepared but disabled behind `pg17_enabled = false`. Plans are clean, nothing was applied, and commits 9d41c0e, a2b7f55, c58e1fa cover the module, staging, and lint fixes.

- [en-cours] Staging pg_partman 4.7.4 → 5.1.0 upgrade on 16.4 (ALTER EXTENSION + check run_maintenance_proc on events_raw/events_daily) before the blue/green switchover — recorded as todo, nothing run against the DB
- [prochaine-étape] Get Maya's sign-off on the whole upgrade
- [prochaine-étape] After sign-off, apply staging (plan already saved as pg17.plan), then pick a prod window avoiding the dbt lock (01:00–03:30 UTC); candidate slots: Sat/Sun 04:00–06:00 UTC
- [essai-raté] Initial `terraform init` failed (lock file vs new constraint); `init -upgrade` pulled aws v6.4.0, whose breaking changes polluted the plan with 37 unrelated changes
- [question] Prod cutover date still undecided, pending Maya's approval
- [décision] Plan only, no apply of anything (source: t01)
- [décision] Pin AWS provider to ~> 5.82.0, no v6 in this PR (source: t04)
- [décision] pg_partman upgrade is a separate todo, don't run anything against the DB (source: t10)
- [décision] No prod date until Maya signs off; `apply_immediately` stays false and was reverted (source: t14)
